content.text: {"summary":"To implement f_old(q,v,1.5u), every first-layer weight on the force input u (column 2 of W1) is multiplied by 1.5. Biases, all other weights and the output layer are unchanged, so the rest of the function is preserved exactly. Rows 4 and 5 have zero u-weights and need no patch. The estimated_c of about 0.42 is a rough estimate of the damping coefficient.
